legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to quash a criminal case to demonstrate that the continuation of the proceedings would cause irreparable harm.
legal_principles.held: It is agreed between Petitioner No. 2 and O.P. No. 2 that they shall co-operate with each other in getting the above-mentioned criminal cases quashed against each other and their family members from this Hon'ble High Court or any other competent court.

legal_principles.principle: The Family Court of Learned Additional Principal Judge shall decide the Guardianship of the minor girl child.
legal_principles.held: That the Petitioner No. 2 and O.P. No. 2 have mutually agreed that the Family Court of Learned Additional Principal Judge shall decide the Guardianship of the minor girl child namely Anika in Guardianship Case No. 30 of 2018 (Abhishek Singh Versus Madhup Madhumita),

outcome.final_order: This application has been filed under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. for quashing the cognizance order dated 12.09.2022 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Lakhisarai
